class InputReader {
    public Scanner scanner;

    public InputReader(InputStream inputstream) {
        scanner = new Scanner(inputstream);
    }

    public String nextLine() {
        return scanner.nextLine();
    }

    public String next() {
        return scanner.next();
    }

    public long nextLong() {
        return scanner.nextLong();
    }

    public int nextInt() {
        return scanner.nextInt();
    }
}

class TaskC {
    void solve(InputReader in, PrintWriter out) {
        long w = in.nextInt();
        long m = in.nextInt();

        if (m == 1) {
            out.println("YES");
            return;
        }

        Set<Long> possible = new HashSet<>();
        possible.add(1L);
        long power = w;

        for (int i = 1; i <= 60; i++) {
            Set<Long> newPossible = new HashSet<>();
            for (Long val : possible) {
                newPossible.add(val + power);
                newPossible.add(Math.abs(val - power));
            }
            possible.addAll(newPossible);
            if (possible.contains(m)) {
                out.println("YES");
                return;
            }
            if (power > m * w) break;
            power *= w;
        }

        out.println("NO");
    }
}
